description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the HolidayDao data access object, testing various methods related to holiday data retrieval, saving, searching, and deletion within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: HolidayDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HolidayDao data access object methods in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, covering CRUD operations and holiday searches.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the HolidayDao and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetHolidayById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a holiday with specific properties and verifies that the saved entity matches the expected values.

methods.name: testSaveHolidayWithNoId
methods.description: Tests creating a new holiday without an ID and verifies that an ID is assigned upon saving.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDates
methods.description: Tests searching holidays without date filters, expecting all recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDatesAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching holidays with no date filters and excluding recurring holidays, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching holidays with only an end date and excluding recurring, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutToDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching holidays with only a start date and excluding recurring, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests complex search filtering including date ranges and excluding recurring holidays, verifying specific holiday names and counts.

methods.name: testSearchHolidays
methods.description: Tests searching holidays within a date range expecting multiple results with specific names.

methods.name: testGetHolidayByDate
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday by a specific date and verifies the holiday name matches expected.

methods.name: testDeleteHolidays
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple holidays by IDs and verifies the number of deleted records.
